templates.name: Software project: SDLC estimate
templates.description: A classic software development life cycle estimate: kick-off, analysis, implementation, tests, installation and go-live, and project management, sized on a T-shirt scale.

templates.name: Winter E-shop
templates.description: Launching an online fashion shop in 8 stages: kick-off, analysis, legal and compliance, implementation, tests, launch and delivery, marketing and reports. Includes WBS numbers and a scheduled timeline.

templates.name: CRM implementation
templates.description: Building and rolling out a CRM in three stages: contacts and leads (MVP), the sales pipeline with quotes and email sync, then automation, reporting, integrations and data migration.

templates.name: Stripe payment gateway integration
templates.description: Adding Stripe to a web app in three stages: checkout and one-time payments, subscriptions and billing, then refunds, disputes and reconciliation.

templates.name: Small SaaS built with Claude Code
templates.description: A generic plan for a small SaaS built with Claude Code: validation and foundations with the Claude Code setup, an MVP with a private beta, then billing, legal and launch.

templates.name: Jira worktime tracking app
templates.description: A time tracking app for Jira Cloud: time logging and timesheets, reports and approvals, then the paid Atlassian Marketplace release.

templates.name: Hotel multi-outlet POS with fiscal printers
templates.description: One POS for every hotel outlet - reception, cafe, bar, restaurant, golf, spa - on tablets or PCs, with fiscal printers, card terminals, table bills, room charges and board plans.

templates.name: ERP with bookkeeping for US micro businesses
templates.description: An online ERP with simple bookkeeping for US micro businesses: invoicing and online payments, bank feeds and receipts, double-entry ledger, sales tax, 1099 and reports.

templates.name: Women's fashion online store: launch plan and first-year costs
templates.description: Launching a women's fashion online store promoted on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest, with own photo shoots: a hired model, make-up artist and bought studio equipment. Launch period and months 4-12, costs only, in USD.

templates.name: Healthy food and vegetables online store: launch plan and first-year costs
templates.description: Launching a healthy food and vegetables online store on PrestaShop with local delivery: a small rented warehouse, commercial refrigerators and a cold room, packaging, health department permit and US food rules. Costs only, in USD.

templates.name: Handmade merino wool hats and gloves online store: launch plan and first-year costs
templates.description: Launching an online store with hand-knitted merino wool hats and gloves: patterns and prototypes, yarn and home knitters paid per piece, craft fairs, a seasonal peak and an off-season plan. Costs only, in USD.

templates.name: Refurbished iPhone online store: launch plan and first-year costs
templates.description: Launching a refurbished iPhone store: sourcing and trade-ins, grading, diagnostics, certified data erasure, repair bench, warranty, own store and marketplaces. Costs only, in USD.

templates.name: Online pharmacy: launch plan and first-year costs
templates.description: Launching a US online pharmacy: state licenses, digital pharmacy accreditation, HIPAA, licensed facility, pharmacy system with e-prescribing, cold-chain shipping, pharmacist staffing. Costs only, in USD.
